name: Icon
description: Draws an icon from the system library (Lucide) with consistent size and accessibility. Inherits the text color.

dos: Use only icons from `icons/registry.json`. If one is missing, add it to the registry before using it.
Decorative icon (accompanies text): no `label`; the component hides it from screen readers.
Icon that conveys something on its own: always provide `label`.
Let the color be inherited from the parent component's text; do not color it separately.

donts.why: A bare icon is neither interactive nor has an accessible name.

donts.useInstead: Importing from the generated icons file
donts.why: Increases bundle size and bypasses the registry of allowed icons.

donts.case: Emoji or image as an icon
donts.why: They do not inherit color or size and look different on each system.

related.difference: Receives it as icon / iconEnd, sized by size.
Receives it as icon; it is its only content, sized by size (16 / 16 / 18 / 20).
Receives it as icon, 14px at size 1 and 16px at sizes 2 and 3.

semantics.role: img (only if there is a label; otherwise aria-hidden)

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon component, imported from the file generated from icons/registry.json.

props.name: size
props.description: Size in px. Set by the parent component according to its size: Button and IconButton 16 / 16 / 18 / 20; TextField 14 / 16 / 16.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without label, the icon is decorative and gets aria-hidden.

root.description: The icon. Inherits the color via currentColor.

height.note: Square: width = height. No icon size token in Figma.

a11y.role: img only if there is a label
a11y.name: label; without label, aria-hidden

cases: with label it has role="img" and aria-label

needsReview: The Radix Figma file uses its own icons (default instance swap "Design / blending-mode" and similar). The system uses Lucide: the look changes and each icon in Figma must be reviewed.
strokeWidth 2 is Lucide's default value, not taken from Figma. Radix Icons are 15px with a different stroke: decide whether to adjust it to 1.5.
The sizes 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 come from Button and TextField; there is no icon size token.
The Figma anchor has no node: the component does not exist as such in the file.
